launchpads_by_id.description:
**Description**

This endpoint provides basic metrics for specific launchpad. It offers details such as the launchpad's `id`, `slug`, `name`, `type`, `rank`, `logo`, `currentROI`, `projectsCount`, `topProjects1Y`, `totalRaised`, `TopCategory1Y`.

**Pricing**
- Each request costs 1 credit.

### Access & Availability
- ✅ Included in: Advanced, Pro, Business
- ❌ Not available in: Sandbox, Basic

news_map.description:
**Description**

This endpoint returns the full list of available news categories and news sources with their IDs. These IDs can be used as filters in the `/news/feed` endpoint (parameters `tagId` and `sources`). Each item includes identifiers, names, and additional metadata for correct filtering and referencing.

**Pricing**
- Each request costs 1 credit.

### Access & Availability
- ✅ Included in: Sandbox, Basic, Advanced, Pro, Business

news_feed.description:
**Description**

This endpoint returns a feed of crypto-related news from external sources (only News, excluding internal articles and premium content). Supports pagination using `limit` and `skip`, as well as sorting by `publishedAt`. Additional filters include `tagId` (retrieved via `/news/map`), `symbol`, and `sourceId`. The response provides metadata such as `id`, `publishedAt`, `url`, `title`, `description`, `source` (`id`, `name`, `url`), and associated `coins` (`id`, `name`, `slug`, `symbol`).
For an example of the type of data returned, visit: https://cryptorank.io/news.

**Pricing**
- Pagination is set to 100 projects per page;
- 1 credit per request for up to 100 results, 2 credits for 101–200, and so on;
- Each request costs 1 credit for up to 100 entries, with additional credits for larger queries or filter usage;
- +1 additional credit if filtering is applied.

### Access & Availability
- ✅ Included in: Advanced, Pro, Business
- ❌ Not available in: Sandbox, Basic

token_platforms_map.description:
